title: A short history of the printing press and of the improvements in printing machinery from the time of Gutenberg up to the present day

Each chapter builds upon the previous ones to illustrate a timeline of technological advancements that not only increased the speed and capacity of printers but also shaped the development of modern newspapers and book publishing.
